deep.reconstruction:
This page is printed, not handwritten. It is p. 114, the last text page of a textbook printed in Wolfenbüttel in 1790 by the Bindseil press (imprint at the foot of the page). The book is probably the arithmetic/algebra schoolbook of Christian Leiste, which would explain the bundle name 'HB.Leiste'. The next page is the printed errata list (Druckfehler). There is no handwriting by Gauss on this page.

What the page continues: on p. 113 the book develops continued fractions for approximating a fraction m/(am+n). It derives the general convergents:
- 1/(a+1/p) = p/(ap+1);
- 1/(a+1/(p+1/t)) = (tp+1)/(atp+t+a);
- 1/(a+1/(p+1/(t+1/u))) = (p(ut+1)+u)/(a(put+p+u)+ut+1).
It then takes as its example the ratio diameter : circumference = 10000000000/31415926536 = [0; 3, 7, 15, 1, ...]. The first convergent given there is 7/22.

This page:
(1) Third-level convergent with a=3, p=7, t=15: 1/(3+1/(7+1/15)).
- Printed as (15·7+1)/(3·15·7+15+1) = 106/331.
- Correct value: 7+1/15 = 106/15, so 3+15/106 = 333/106, giving 106/333.
- By the book's own formula the denominator is atp+t+a = 315+15+3 = 333.
(2) Fourth-level convergent with u=1: 1/(3+1/(7+1/(15+1/1))).
- The formula gives (7(15+1)+1)/(3(7·15+7+1)+15+1) = 113/(3·113+16) = 113/355. This is correct.
(3) Error claim: 113/355 is smaller than the given fraction by not quite 3/10^8.
- Check: 10^10/31415926536 ≈ 0.31830988618, and 113/355 ≈ 0.31830985915.
- The difference is ≈ 2.70e-8, which is indeed below 3e-8. The claim is correct.
(4) Bibliographic note: a fuller treatment of continued fractions is referred to Hellwig, 'Anfangsgründe der allgemeinen Mathematik und der Arithmetik', Braunschweig 1777.

The page then ends with the colophon.
errors: The third convergent is misprinted as 106/331. The denominator should be 3·15·7+15+3 = 333, i.e. atp+t+a with a=3, so the convergent is 106/333. The printed '+1' wrongly carries over a=1 from the earlier 345/437 example. This slip is not listed in the following errata page.

results.what: Successive convergents of the continued fraction of 1/π: 7/22, 106/333, 113/355, with an error estimate for 113/355
results.modern_name: Continued-fraction convergents (best rational approximations) of 1/π; Zu Chongzhi/Metius ratio 355/113
results.usually_credited_to: 355/113: Zu Chongzhi (5th c.), Adriaan Anthonisz/Metius (16th c.). Continued-fraction convergents: Huygens, Wallis, Euler (17th–18th c.)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a page of a printed 1790 Wolfenbüttel schoolbook (probably Leiste's) containing standard continued-fraction approximations of π. There is no Gauss content beyond the book possibly having belonged to him.

checkable.asserts: Third convergent is 106/333, not the printed 106/331
The printed denominator arithmetic gives 331, showing the slip of +1 instead of +a
The book's explicit numerator/denominator arithmetic is correct
113/355 is smaller than the given ratio by less than 3/10^8 (difference ≈ 2.70e-8)

transcription_corrections: The page is printed, not a manuscript. The machine transcription of '106/331' faithfully reproduces the misprint; the mathematically correct value is 106/333.
'Hrn. Prof. Joh. Christian Lud. Hellwig' is correctly read: Johann Christian Ludwig Hellwig, Braunschweig 1777.
